timeline.Mara Quill: At 10:11 p.m. in the restoration room, Mara used her staff credential, poisoned Alistair through a cut on his finger, and then left through the interior archive corridor, although she later claimed to have been at the loading dock.
timeline.Rowan Saye: At 10:11 p.m. in the west exhibition hall, Rowan was being photographed by three visiting patrons while arguing with a buyer about a different painting.
timeline.Dr. Elian Moss: At 10:11 p.m. in the basement conservation lab, Elian was rinsing solvent from a damaged frame under the lab's running camera.
timeline.Petra Venn: At 10:11 p.m. in the crowded foyer, Petra was assisting a caterer who had dropped a tray of glasses near the entrance.

statements.Mara Quill: From 10:08 to 10:18 p.m., I remained at the loading dock, attending to the evening deliveries. I had no reason to go near the restoration room while the guests were inside.
statements.Rowan Saye: Venn’s accusation about forged provenance papers gave me every reason to be furious, and I did argue publicly that evening about a separate sale. At 10:11 p.m., three visiting patrons were photographing me in the west exhibition hall while I disputed that sale with a buyer.
statements.Dr. Elian Moss: Venn’s plan to dismiss me over the error in my authentication report was deeply humiliating, but I stayed at my assigned work. At 10:11 p.m., I was in the basement conservation lab rinsing solvent from a damaged frame beneath the running camera.
statements.Petra Venn: Being removed from Venn’s will after I borrowed against the family artwork left our relationship bitter, and I have not hidden that dispute. At 10:11 p.m., I was in the crowded foyer helping a caterer gather glasses after a tray fell near the entrance.
